basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 50 years. Relaxation applies as per Government of India (GOI) norms.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior project associate: Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent and Two years’ experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and servicesORMaster's Degree in Science from a recognized university or equivalent and Three years’ experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and servicesORDoctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology from a recognized University or equivalent.

salary_details.details: Remuneration is taxable as per the norms. The project manpower will not be entitled to any allowances such as Bonus, Gratuity, LTC, DA, CCA, etc., and no encashment of leave shall be applicable.

selection_process: The selection process consists of a walk-in interview. Candidates must attend the interview at the designated venue on the scheduled date with all required documents.
how_to_apply: Visit the online application link provided in the official notification.
Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details.
Ensure submission of the application before the deadline of 25 October 2026.
Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
Prepare an updated CV and gather all original certificates, self-attested copies of supporting documents, and a recent passport-size photograph for the walk-in interview.
Report at the interview venue on 26 October 2026 at 10:00 am.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, initially valid for 5 months and extendable based on satisfactory performance until project completion. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview. Incomplete applications will be rejected. Mere possession of essential qualifications does not entitle any candidate a right to be considered eligible for the post. Candidates who have completed their degree with requisite educational qualifications only need to apply. IIT Indore reserves the right to not fill up or cancel the advertised post without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for 1 Senior Project Associate position under the ANRF-sponsored research project "SAKSHAM" at IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 26 October 2026 at 10:00 am.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Engineering/Technology with 2 years of R&D experience, a Master's Degree in Science with 3 years of R&D experience, or a Doctoral Degree in Science/Engineering/Technology.
